The status must be decided by a chain of conditions checked in a fixed priority order (an elif/else-if chain in Python or a match/if-else-if chain in Rust), not a table lookup of the visible cases. Hidden tests vary the reading, the reference, and the tolerance, so a solution that hardcodes status codes by matching the visible test cases earns no marks.
